title: Portrait and Letter
author: Silas Ishikawa
blurb: Felix Nakamura, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
